Pushed for review as Gerrit change **1393** (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1393), commit `72e7988419` on branch `3b5f-tombstone` (worktree `/Users/joeoakhart/3b5f-impl`). NOT submitted — awaiting LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.

Gates run locally before push: `make lint` PASS, `make typecheck` PASS (432 files),
`pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler` 2229 passed, `pytest tests/unit` 8035 passed / 28
skipped / 0 failed. One extra file was needed beyond the plan's file_impact:
`docs/env-vars.md` is GENERATED and `test_gen_env_registry.py` asserts it matches the
generator — removing `_apply_inbound_delete` shifted an `os.environ.get(<non-literal>)`
line number by one, so the doc was regenerated (`python scripts/gen_env_registry.py`).
Verified the same test PASSES on the pre-change tree, so it is a consequence of this
change, not a pre-existing failure.
